items.title: Example 8.87
items.prompt_text: When Raoul runs on the treadmill at the gym, the number of calories, c , he burns varies directly with the number of minutes, m , he uses the treadmill. He burned 315 calories when he used the treadmill for 18 minutes. ⓐ Write the equation that relates c and m . ⓑ How many calories would he burn if he ran on the treadmill for 25 minutes?
